horizontalChoice: Integer-metre point at the Alexander II statue, centre of Senate Square, bounded by the University main building and the Government Palace footprints (City of Helsinki building register).

localFrames.working: X east, Y north, Z up (metres, after subtracting originProjected); used by the cell builder and Blender
localFrames.runtime: X east, Y up, Z south: runtime = (E - E0, H - H0, -(N - N0))

heightDerivation.method: least-squares plane through the city terrain model (2021_terrain) on a 1 m grid over an 8 to 20 m annulus around (E0, N0), one 0.5 m rejection pass (tools/world/derive_origin_height.ts)

openIssues: Three control points (Cathedral, Railway Station, Market Square quay) are the permanent re-tiling test; only the Cathedral lies inside the pilot.
